subject: Delegated approval paths + secret access matrix — SIG evidence package
messages:
From: Acme Security <security@acmesec.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: delegated approvals & secret custody breakdown

Hi Evelyn / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of our SIG assessment we need a delivery that shows: 1) delegated approval paths for code changes that affect model-serving infra (who can approve what at each stage), 2) the current secret access matrix (which roles/service accounts have access to which vault paths), and 3) a short export of CI gating rules that enforce PR reviews/branch protection.

Ideally we get a single package that includes: a simple diagram/PDF of the approval flow, a CSV of the secret access matrix, and excerpts from your CI/CD policy with links to the PR gating rules. Can you confirm scope (prod-only vs prod+staging) and estimated delivery?

Thanks,
Amir Khan
Senior Assessor
Acme Security

(Attachment: request-checklist.pdf)

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: delegated approvals & secret custody breakdown

Marissa / Jordan / Karthik — assigning tasks from Acme's request:

- Marissa: can you pull the delegated approval diagram and a brief write-up of approval thresholds (who approves config vs code vs infra changes) for prod and prod-adjacent (hotfixes in staging that are promoted)? PDF preferred.
- Jordan: please export the secrets access matrix for vault paths under /prod/model-serving and /prod/services including service accounts, role bindings, KMS key access. A CSV with columns (principal, path, access, justification, last_review) works.
- Karthik: quick extract of CI gating rules (our repo-level branch protection + required reviewers, status checks, and any auto-merge exceptions). If there are policy snippets, include those as .md.

Goal: compile into a single package for Acme by EOD Pacific today if feasible. If any step needs legal/infra sign-off that will push timeline, flag immediately.

I'll coordinate delivery once we have drafts.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

(Internal note: keep PII out of matrices.)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: delegated approvals & secret custody breakdown

Evelyn — attaching my interim pieces.

Attachment: delegated-approval-flow.pdf (diagram + legend)
Attachment: secrets-access-matrix-20280602.csv (interim export, redacted columns for owner emails)

Notes:
- The approval diagram shows three lanes: Engineering (code PR approvals), Infra (infrastructure change board + infra leads), and Security (final signoff for changes touching secrets or KMS). For prod changes, at least one infra lead + one peer reviewer required; for config toggles that affect routing we require Security review.
- The CSV includes principals, vault paths, access levels, and last_review dates. I redacted owner personal emails where they exceed scope and added a justification column for service accounts that have cross-team access.

Question: do we include ephemeral token issuance logs (created by the ephemeral-proxy) as part of the matrix, or only the static vault binding table? Acme asked about token lifecycle evidence in their checklist.

—Marissa
Sr. Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: security@acmesec.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: delegated approvals & secret custody breakdown

Amir — attaching the requested package for your review. Links and attachments below:

- delegated-approval-flow.pdf (diagram and approval thresholds)
- secrets-access-matrix-20280602.csv (redacted export; includes vault path, principal, access, justification, last_review)
- ci-cd-policy-extract.md (branch protection and required checks excerpt)
- supplementary: instruction.txt (notes about token lifecycle logs and how to request them)

We included both prod and prod-adjacent (staging->prod promotion) controls per your checklist. For token lifecycle evidence: we can provide an ephemeral-token-issuance.csv that lists token IDs and TTL windows, but that file is gated and requires a short access request to infra (for auditing reasons). See Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-SIG-evidence (view-only).

Deliverables also referenced in JIRA-SEC-4127. If you need the gated logs, reply and we'll raise the infra access request immediately.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

(Attachments: delegated-approval-flow.pdf; secrets-access-matrix-20280602.csv; ci-cd-policy-extract.md; instruction.txt)
